description_en: Queries the list of host shared keys
description_zh: 查询主机共享密钥的列表
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost list-host-share-keys --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListHostShareKeys

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID of the Bastionhost instance.
You can invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的实例ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the Bastionhost instance.
For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的地域ID。
Region ID和地域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 设置从返回结果的第几页开始显示查询结果。默认值为1，表示从第1页开始显示
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: Specifies the Settings for the number of host shared keys to return on each page during a paged query. Default value: 20, which indicates that 20 host shared keys are returned per page during paging
parameters.help_zh: 设置分页查询时，每页显示的主机共享密钥的数量。默认值为20，表示每页显示20条主机共享密钥
parameters.name: page_size

HostAccountCount.description_en: The number of associated host accounts

HostShareKeyId.description_en: The ID of the host shared key

HostShareKeyName.description_en: The name of the host shared key

LastModifyKeyAt.description_en: The time when the key was last modified. The value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds
LastModifyKeyAt.description_zh: 密钥上次修改的时间（秒，时间戳格式）

PrivateKeyFingerPrint.description_en: The fingerprint of the private key

RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of host shared keys returned
TotalCount.description_zh: 查询到的主机共享密钥的总数量
